newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March trade gap narrows on record exports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March trade gap narrows on record exports.

text.p: Record overseas sales helped shrink the U.S. trade deficit by a dramatic 19.3 percent to $8.51 billion during March, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday.
Total exports increased 4.1 percent from February to a record $76.48 billion on strong demand for American-made aircraft, capital goods like telecommunications equipment and consumer goods.
Imports grew a more modest 1.2 percent to $84.99 billion, also a record, kept in check by a lower value of imported cars and parts, primarily from Canada.
